name: Bug report
about: Something is wrong or a score looks wrong

**What did you do?** (page, button, or API call)

**What did you expect, and what happened?**

**For a wrong score or label:** the alert's link, and what the type or severity should have been. (Please also use "Is this right?" on the alert so it is counted.)

**Where did it happen?** (live site, local run, CI)

Please do not paste real credentials, personal data or leaked content.
